title: Israeli settler violence in West Bank reported up 42%
detail: Reports on Nov 22-24 describe a sharp rise in Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank: monthly attacks reportedly rose from 647 in September to 1,369 in October, per figures cited in coverage; the UN deputy chief said on Nov 23 that settler violence is driving families from their homes at record rates. Baselines differ between sources and the 42% figure is not independently reconciled.

media.caption: Jewish settler violence in West Bank sees surge over two years
